notes.title: Please vote for this game in the Steam Awards 🙏
notes.content:
To all the players who have played this game, thank you very much!

If you don't mind, I would be really happy if you could vote for this game in the Steam Awards.

We are planning more updates and localizations into languages other than Japanese, so please continue to support our game!
